title: Nitocris (Netjerkare Siptah)
summary: Queen of Egypt at the end of Dynasty 6.
description: Queen of Egypt at the end of Dynasty 6. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Argument 2. The Durations Form an Interlocking Matrix", Table 1 (AP-16 row)
reign.note: Table 1: "Approximate reign of Nitocris aka Netjerkare Siptah" (AP-16, from CFAH-3). The anchor point itself is on the event reign-of-nitocris.

reign.date: Start Sole-rex: 1491; End Sole-rex: 1485; Death or Deposition: 1479
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 16 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 6", p. 104
Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 115; Manetho, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 54 to 59, and Eusebius, Chronicle 14 and 15
reign.note: She built the third pyramid. Eratosthenes' Nitocris (p. 140, 6 years) is not placed on this record.

free_source_links.locator: "Argument 2. The Durations Form an Interlocking Matrix", Table 1 (AP-16 row)
